title: Browser sign-in calls
responsibility: Expose the browser-facing authentication endpoints through the supplied API client.

inputs.name: browserAuth.api
inputs.description: The required BrowserApi client used to send each authentication request. This function does not wrap or translate the client's request failures.

outputs.name: browserAuth
outputs.type: { status: () => Promise<AuthStatus>; challenge: () => Promise<LoginChallenge>; google: (credential: string, csrf: string) => Promise<SignInResult>; emailStart: () => Promise<SignInResult>; emailVerify: (code: string) => Promise<SignInResult>; logout: () => Promise<{ ok: boolean; }>; nativeRequest: (handoffId: string) => Promise<NativeRequest>; nativeApprove: (handoffId: string, userCode: string) => Promise<{ approved: boolean; resource: string; }>; }
outputs.description: A set of seven methods that delegate to BrowserApi for status and challenge requests, Google and email sign-in, logout, and native handoff polling and approval. Each method returns its API call's typed promise, sends the request fields shown in its endpoint call, and leaves identity decisions to the server.
